answer: Each identity may endorse only 5 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 900 aliases need 900 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. What carries the trellis here is verification, the dune of cost is what stops the farm, and the ridge of the record keeps every claim checkable.
